title: Steady Ember Calm

diffuser.notes: Run 15–20 minutes in a busy room; refresh later if needed.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist away from face.

why_it_works: Petitgrain brings a clean, citrus-leaf lift while vetiver and sweet marjoram add a soft, grounded base—calm without heaviness.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
